summary: folder-lint preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: On `npm install`, the package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-mangled identifiers and property-indirection aliases, and `math_init.js` is an opaque Bun-cjs bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a numeric string-array plus decoder function — a shape that hides URLs, commands, and strings from static review. The package presents itself as a folder-linting library and has no functional need for an alternate language runtime. Fetching a second runtime solely to execute an unreadable bundle at install time bypasses Node-only tooling and delivers attacker-chosen code into the installer's environment without any user action beyond `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
